命中率 = 缓存读取 Token / 输入 Token（promptTokens: Hit rate = cache-read tokens / input tokens (promptTokens). The shorter the window, the closer it is to "right now": when an upstream reports cache reads separately from input, this ratio can legitimately exceed 100%; it is shown as-is, without clamping.
所选范围内暂无请求: No requests in the selected range
所选范围内每个提供商各消耗了多少 Token，按 Token 用量从多到少排。同: How many tokens each provider used in the selected range, sorted by token usage from high to low. The same model name may be offered by several providers; the Gateway tries them in priority order as configured in the Forwarding route setting, so the share also reflects where requests actually landed. Percentages are based on the total tokens for the range (this block only looks at usage; request counts and success rates are in the overview cards). "Unknown" means those requests did not record the provider that served them—mainly detail rows from before provider recording existed, and requests that failed before an upstream was chosen (invalid request body, model not found, no available account). This dimension differs from accounts: old detail rows have no "which provider served it" information at all (early versions had a single upstream, but that was a configuration fact, not a per-request record), so they cannot be recomputed and old data stays in "Unknown" forever; requests created from now on all record their specific provider.
所选范围内每个提供商各消耗了多少 Token，按用量从多到少排，扇区角度即占比。: How many tokens each provider used in the selected range, sorted by usage from high to low; each sector's angle is its share. The same model name may be offered by several providers; the Gateway tries them in priority order as configured in the Forwarding route setting, so the share also reflects where requests actually landed. The center shows the total for this dimension (equal to Total tokens in the overview), and each row on the right gives that provider's token usage and percentage. "Unknown" means those requests did not record the provider that served them—mainly detail rows from before provider recording existed, and requests that failed before an upstream was chosen.
所选范围内每个模型各消耗了多少 Token，按用量从多到少排，扇区角度即占比。中: How many tokens each model used in the selected range, sorted by usage from high to low; each sector's angle is its share. The center shows the total for this dimension (equal to Total tokens in the overview), and each row on the right gives that model's token usage and percentage. Percentages inside sectors are labeled only when ≥3%; smaller ones would crowd together—full readings are in the list on the right and in hover tooltips. Colors are assigned by usage rank: the largest sector is red, and so on down the line; switching dimensions in the same report keeps the same color scheme.
所选范围内每个账号各消耗了多少 Token，按 Token 用量从多到少排。账号: How many tokens each account used in the selected range, sorted by token usage from high to low. Accounts are a finer dimension than providers: one provider can have several accounts, and requests try each account along the candidate chain by priority, so this reflects which specific login session is doing the work. Percentages are based on the total tokens for the range (this block only looks at usage; request counts and success rates are in the overview cards). "Unknown account" means those requests had no account identity: this happens when forwarding through the default login session (no account list configured); old aggregate rows written before this dimension existed also lack account details, but they are recomputed automatically from detail records at startup—only days whose details have already been purged by the retention period (30 days by default) cannot be recovered and remain in "Unknown account"; those are genuinely unrecoverable.
